nan.interpretation: NaN fails any 0<=x<=1 test; NaN inside the owner-mirror template footprint is consistent with the user-reported portal range error, but the organizer validator and template authenticity were not independently verified. The allfinite variant passes the local whole-array range check but emits ~12% of the template footprint (~12x the dotted file pixel count) and half of its positives lie outside the template footprint.
